hooks.command: root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && test -r "$root/.codex/hooks/stop-check.sh" && sh "$root/.codex/hooks/stop-check.sh" || printf '%s\n' '{"decision":"block","reason":"Unable to run the required static source checks."}'
hooks.statusMessage: Checking source policies, dependencies, public APIs, and lint findings
